observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down the basic steps step-by-step with clear verbal instructions and counts. She progresses from footwork to speed, arms, and finally full practice with music.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the first basic step of Jota
Explanation of foot position and alternate feet crossing
Practicing the footwork a bit faster
Adding small hops on the tips of the feet

metaphors: como si estuviéramos en una cueca
common_mistakes: No se nos pueden caer los brazos

steps_taught.name: Paso básico de la jota
steps_taught.description: Right foot crosses in front of left, left lifts behind, then alternate.

what_works: Progressive layering from feet to hops to arms
what_hinders: Lack of musical counts during practice

quotes.text: el primer paso que vamos a aprender de la jota
cuando lo realicemos con la música debemos darle pequeños saltitos

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands facing front with hands together, explaining starting position.
Demonstrating right and left foot crosses behind/in front with hands behind back.

extraction.distinctive_method: Isolating feet first, adding hops, then arms, and finally pairing with music.
